pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

3. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 30
   C. 45
   D. 36

5. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 14
   C. 22
   D. 28

7. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 16

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

12. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
